findings.passage: "Keeping illegals from voting and working here, keeping men out of womens' sports. We have lowered the income tax (in Kentucky). That's something we could do in Congress as well," Gordon said.
findings.note: Direct quote of Gordon in a LEX 18 interview on the day she announced her 2025 run for Congress (she later ended that run and sought re-election to the House). Asked what else she likes about the country's direction, she lists keeping noncitizens from voting among her priorities. No mention of ID or proof of citizenship.
